newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLERS ON 3-HOUR STRIKE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLERS ON 3-HOUR STRIKE.

text.p: Flights were delayed at Helsinki-Vantaa airport on Monday morning after air traffic controllers began a three-hour strike at 0600/0400 GMT, local media reported.

Airport manager Heikki Hanninen told Finnish radio that some domestic flights had to be cancelled, but that for the most part air traffic -- both incoming and outgoing -- was running with only minor delays.
Flights from Helsinki to Tampere, Oulu, Joensuu and Kokkola were cancelled, Hanninen said, but efforts were made to arrange alternative transport.
The strike was in protest at the aviation authorities' hiring policy and affected about 20 airports, local media reported.
Traffic was expected to return to normal soon after 0900/0700 GMT.
